why: This version tests something no command returns: nothing the playbook can read says whether a task is urgent. Never stand another field in for it (the kind, a word in the title): that draft would check, its cases would pass because you wrote them, and it would save. Ask, name the sentence, and end.
run: The document gives an urgent task one minute, but nothing this playbook can read says whether a task is urgent: it sees only a task's kind, title and description and who filed it. How should an urgent task be recognised, or should this sentence go?
